label: PF Backlog 34
title: Detect + retry empty/truncated/reasoning-only agent artifacts; never cache them
body:
Stage 1 design artifact (products/ProductForge-Dashboard/artifacts/1/design-output.md) was 1188 bytes containing ONLY the model reasoning trace ('Here is a thinking process...'), missing every essential section (functional_requirements, non_functional_requirements, user_stories, api_contracts). Root cause: on a truncated response the pipeline issues a 'Continue exactly where you stopped' continuation prompt; the free model (nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning:free via OpenRouter) replied with chain-of-thought instead of content; that bad reply was written to products/

/.llm-cache and re-served as a CACHE HIT on rerun. Fix: validate agent output (min length + required sections); if empty/truncated/reasoning-only, do NOT cache it, do NOT hand it to the compliance checklist as a real artifact, and retry with the next fallback model.
